egress.terms: not published: the Cloud Studio billing page prices machine-hours per shape and states no egress allowance or overage price

interface_detail: Tencent Cloud API 3.0 (workspace create, modify, stop, query; API Explorer) and a browser IDE with terminal; free high-performance workspaces do not support API calls

a prepaid resource package deducts machine-hours until it is exhausted, then billing switches to pay-as-you-go automatically

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.
